evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We study hallucination detection as a benchmark-conditioned measurement problem and organize existing benchmarks along three axes: provenance, which describes how model outputs and evidence conditions are obtained; typology, which captures the factuality and faithfulness failures represented by benchmark labels; and granularity, which specifies the unit at which hallucinations are annotated, predicted, and evaluated.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We also examine span-level evaluation, where variation in annotation boundaries can substantially affect reported results, and propose Span Coverage F1 as a complementary containment-based metric.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: However, existing methods are often compared across benchmarks that define and measure hallucination in substantially different ways, making reported scores difficult to interpret across settings.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Our analysis clarifies what detector scores capture, highlights limitations of cross-benchmark comparisons, and motivates more explicit evaluation of generalization across benchmark conditions.
